review.rationale: 原两版真实hash及各自100%/80%基础承伤比例保留；最新回答负先制取绝对值、承伤最低0，最低红及受击后回复均按该确定值计算。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 敌实际技能先制按绝对值调整：承伤比例max(0,基础-15%*绝对先制)，最低红比例40%+5%*绝对先制；正负等值实际封顶伤害与HP恢复一致；零承伤不触正伤回血，超过100%最低红保留完整伤害与实际HP损失；固定追加与死后次回合封先制保留。

success.assertion: test('4887真实两版先制上限0保留负先制、属性和攻击生效但血药不被降先制，原生先制3也受限',()=>{for(const id of[2074,2103])for(const move of[38325,20530,10499]){const s=V(id).make({move,soul:true});timer(s,0,'属性技能先制',{amount:2});timer(s,0,'攻击先制',{amount:2});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);}const s=make({move:10499,soul:true});turn(s,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,100);});

success.name: 4887真实2074/2103零及正先制的承伤比例、红伤最低值、追加固定和受攻击后回复按API；伤免零红不追加
success.assertion:
test('4887真实2074/2103零及正先制的承伤比例、红伤最低值、追加固定和受攻击后回复按API；伤免零红不追加',()=>{for(const id of[2074,2103])for(const p of[0,1,2,5]){const s=V(id).make({move:10499,soul:true,hp:9000,bStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});s.moveDefinitions[key(10716)].priority=p;turn(s,10499,10716);const state=s.fighters[0].soulState.torus4887,base=id===2074?1:.8;assert.ok(Math.abs(state.capFraction-(base-.15*p))<1e-9);assert.ok(Math.abs(state.floorFraction-(.4+.05*p))<1e-9);const hit=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.targetSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.ok(hit.settledDamage<=Math.floor(9000*state.capFraction));if(s.fighters[0].hp>0){const own=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.targetSide===1&&e.type==='attack');assert.ok(own.settledDamage>=Math.floor(9000*state.floorFraction));assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),Math.floor(500*state.floorFraction));}}
 const z=make({move:10499,soul:true});timer(z,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(z);assert.equal(sum(z),0);assert.equal(sum(z,'fixed'),0);

success.name: 4887真实两版受攻击后魂印回复不受技能禁疗；固定百分比真实伤害不适用红伤上限也不触发该回血
success.assertion: test('4887真实两版受攻击后魂印回复不受技能禁疗；固定百分比真实伤害不适用红伤上限也不触发该回血',()=>{for(const id of[2074,2103]){const s=V(id).make({move:20530,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,20530,10127);const damage=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.targetSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000-damage.hpLoss+(id===2074?200:240));for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const a=V(id).make({move:20530,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100,'非红不回复',type);},()=>turn(a,20530,20117));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,900);}}});

success.name: 4887真实2074/2103负敌先制取绝对、承伤比例最低零已答；死亡使当前敌下回合先制归零
success.assertion: test('4887真实2074/2103负敌先制取绝对、承伤比例最低零已答；死亡使当前敌下回合先制归零',()=>{for(const id of[2074,2103])for(const p of[-1,7]){const s=V(id).make({move:10499,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].priority=p;turn(s);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.torus4887;assert.equal(st.effectiveOpponentPriority,Math.abs(p));assert.equal(st.capFraction,Math.max(0,((id===2074?100:80)-15*Math.abs(p))/100));}const s=make({move:20530,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{spe:1}});turn(s,20530,10716);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['先制效果失效'].start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['先制效果失效'].end,2);});
